facts.fact: The BCEAO set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions of the Union to open PI-SPI instant payment services (30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions), replacing 30 June 2026; the communique is dated 25 June 2026 and covers all WAEMU members, including Benin.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
